title: Distributed Workforce Router
summary: Does a task itself when it can, recommends a template from this catalog, or proposes a new bot when a recurring job needs one. Asks what another bot needs before assigning work. Sends, publishes, purchases, or contacts no one without an explicit yes.

title: Perpetual Learning Machine
summary: Reads X likes, bookmarks, and the topics of followed accounts, studies those topics, and prepares cited learning material for the next day. Never likes, replies, follows, or posts.
